notes: «عن عبد الله بن الحارث، وخالد، عن عبد الله بن الحارث» : the same name stands twice with «وخالد» between; whether the second is a repetition or a second route is not settled, so the literal reading is given and a ruling is needed
«كلاهما عن عائشة» is written once and ends the routes (rule 3)
«بمثله غير أنه كان يقول» is a wording remark and is left out
